text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The dish served at that establishment... 
Fufu, it was a masterpiece truly befitting 
the celebration of my life.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to thank you once again, 
Buena-san. You really know such wonderful 
places.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ Yeah, the carrots from that salad 
place really are delicious, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I found it, I always thought, 
"I have to hold Desire-chan's birthday 
party here!" ...So I'm really glad you 
like it♪

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. With the vitality bestowed upon me by 
that magnificent dish, the light dwelling 
within me shines even brighter.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Such a wonderful establishment surely 
deserves the blessing of the Holy Maiden—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Rating: 5/5 stars. The instant I opened 
the menu, my eyes were stolen by none 
other than the 'Explosion of Desire☆Carrot 
Bowl'—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I ordered this drawn in by the impactful 
name, but honestly, it far exceeded my 
expectations in taste!! It brings out the 
carrot's sweetness and aroma in the best 
way poss—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... What a detailed and wonderful 
review...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"'—And the surprise birthday performance 
was also absolutely wonderful.' ...Post."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Shining the righteous light on what 
deserves praise— This, too, is the mission 
of a saint..."
